To summarize, since this replication attempt did not model the kinetics of the mouse model as they occurred in the original study, these data are unable to address whether, under the conditions of the original study, NC101 and NC101

differ in inflammation, invasion, and neoplasia.
decisions.reason: Because the experimental endpoint in the mouse model ran 9 weeks longer than in the original study due to unclear timing descriptions in the original paper, the authors explicitly conclude that their data cannot be directly compared to the original study and are unable to address the central claim regarding differences in inflammation, invasion, and neoplasia (Figure 4A-F). Preliminary bacterial growth/colonization checks and exploratory survival comparisons do not override the authors' explicit substantive verdict that this replication attempt cannot adjudicate the central finding, which codes as 'uninformative' under the codebook.
